newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian textile firm makes lower profit in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian textile firm makes lower profit in 95/96.

text.p: United Arab Spinning and Weaving/Unirab made net attributable profits of 13.754 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, 52 percent down on 28.590 million in the previous year, an official source at the Public Enterprise Ministry said on Wednesday.
The financial year ends on June 30.
The profits, which are not audited, are equivalent to 2.41 pounds for each of the 5.704 million shares, which closed at 44.00 pounds on the Egyptian stock exchange on Tuesday.
The state privatised 69,900 of the shares in 1994 and plans to sell off the rest next year, the source said.
The company estimates that shareholders' equity at the end of 1995/6 was 339.1 million pounds, or 59.45 per share.
